synopsis: Keysight’s AD1012A product page claims support for up to 512 objects over a range of 1.5–300 m, with a contiguous horizontal field of view of ±70° and vertical field of view of ±15° [f4548, f4549, f4550]. The separate E8719A data sheet lists support for 1 or 3 radar targets; these figures concern different products, not a demonstrated inconsistency [f5312, f4548]. An industry demonstration involving Keysight, ESTECO, IPG and TNO combined scenario simulation, CarMaker vehicle simulation, HIL radar emulation and probabilistic analysis [f8711]. TNO collaborates with AVL and the Keysight–IPG–ESTECO chain, but the evidence is mostly road automotive, leaving its applicability to heavy off-road machines uncertain [f8830].

relations.note: The joint demonstration provides an example of TNO’s collaboration with the Keysight–IPG–ESTECO chain.
Adds the distance envelope to the AD1012A’s claimed object capacity.
Adds angular coverage to the AD1012A’s claimed object capacity.
